newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil IGP-DI inflation rises 0.70 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Brazil IGP-DI inflation rises 0.70 pct in June.

text.p: Brazil's Indice Geral de Precos - Disponibilidade Interna (IGP-DI) rose 0.70 percent in June, against a 0.30 percent advance in May, the independent research institute Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) said.

The IGP-DI index is a compilation of three indices: the IPA wholesale price index, which rose 0.24 percent in the period; the IPC consumer price index, which advanced 1.30 percent; and the INCC national index of construction costs, which gained 1.11 percent.
The FGV releases the IGP-DI figure once a month.
